Name: Black and White cat
Author: Ciciciron
Description: I created a recolour based on my cat, Dozer- hence the file name once downloaded. Mod requires Content Patcher. Only conflicts with other cat recolour mods that change this specific cat- if you note any issues please let me know. I've never coded before but I ensured it worked, hasn't been tested with anything else. Replaces the grey cat, known as 'cat1' in the files. Is just a visual change. Compatible with 1.6
